# Event types

Every change in Slate is one event. The same shape comes from `GET /events`, the SSE stream (`event:` = type, `id:` = event id), check-in news (plus `why`, `item_title`) and webhooks (plus `item` and `actor` summaries):

```json
{"id": "0Vb3...", "type": "item.updated", "item_id": "Ab12Cd34Ef56", "subject_id": "Ab12Cd34Ef56", "actor_id": "Xy98...", "source": "api", "field": "title", "before": "Old", "after": "New", "session_ref": "run-42", "at": "2026-10-24T01:02:03.456Z"}
```

`id` is time-ordered: `since=<id>` means everything after it. `source` is one of `ui` (the board: REST with `X-Slate-Client: browser` and `X-Slate-Source: ui`), `api` (any other REST call, including the stdio `slate-mcp` bridge), `mcp` (HTTP `/mcp`) or `system` (the scheduler); a caller cannot claim `mcp` or `system`. `subject_id` is the thing changed (the item, list, comment...); `item_id` is set whenever an item is involved.

## account

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `account.created` | A person or agent account was created (`after` = the account). |
| `account.digest` | The daily digest was sent to an account (`after` = its summary). Check-in news `digest`. |
| `account.disabled` | An account was disabled: its tokens stop working at once. |
| `account.enabled` | A disabled account was enabled again. |
| `account.prefs_changed` | Board prefs changed (theme, folded columns). Reaches the account's other devices live. |
| `account.role_changed` | An account's role changed (`field` = `role`: owner, admin, member, guest). Its access changes at once; a stream recomputes it. |
| `account.updated` | An account was renamed (`field` = `display_name`). |

## agent

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `agent.connection_checked` | Private health or heartbeat changed; refetch connection. |
| `agent.connection_connected` | Single-use pairing exchanged for a scoped credential. |
| `agent.connection_created` | A manager issued an expiring code; history carries no secret. |
| `agent.connection_revoked` | Connection credential revoked, not proof of remote termination. |

## automation

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `automation.created` | An automation rule was created. |
| `automation.deleted` | An automation rule was deleted. |
| `automation.secret_rotated` | An automation's incoming-webhook secret was rotated. |
| `automation.updated` | An automation rule changed (or was turned on or off). |

## capacity

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `capacity.reset` | An account's capacity went back to the defaults for its kind. |
| `capacity.set` | An account's capacity changed (hours a day, tasks a day or work days); one event per field, the first one makes the row. |

## channel

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `channel.read` | An account updated its chat read state (subject = the account). Intentional cursor: `after` = {channel, through}; exact exposure: {channel}, plus `through` when the exposures folded into the cursor. Refetch channel counts; this is not a recipient seen receipt. |

## checklist

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `checklist.created` | A checklist was added to an item. |
| `checklist.deleted` | A checklist was removed. |
| `checklist.entry_added` | A checklist entry was added. |
| `checklist.entry_checked` | A checklist entry was ticked. |
| `checklist.entry_removed` | A checklist entry was removed. |
| `checklist.entry_unchecked` | A checklist entry was unticked. |
| `checklist.entry_updated` | A checklist entry's text, position or assignee changed. |
| `checklist.updated` | A checklist was renamed or moved. |

## comment

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `comment.assigned` | A comment was addressed to an account: an Ask, open until resolved (`after.assignee` handle, `assignee_id`, `comment_id`; `assignee` null when taken off; `reply` true when it is the waited-on person's answer to an agent that reported the item blocked on them). Check-in news `asked`, Today `asked`, and a `work` hint for an agent (with `comment_id`, and `reply`). |
| `comment.deleted` | A comment was deleted for good, by its author or an admin (`before` = the comment, with `reactions`). Inboxes and check-in news drop every entry about it. |
| `comment.edited` | A comment's text changed. |
| `comment.reacted` | An emoji reaction was added to a comment. |
| `comment.resolved` | An Ask was explicitly closed (`after.comment_id`, `by`, `reason`). A plain reply never resolves it. |
| `comment.unreacted` | An emoji reaction was removed. |

## doc

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `doc.agent_turn` | An agent's doc turn (`after.agent`, subject = the doc): `state` started (taken with /work/next), done (`reply_id` = its comment, or none), released (given up, nothing posted) or expired (the lease ran out; actor `slate`, `reconciliation_required`); `pending` true when a mention arrived during the turn and waits for the next take. |
| `doc.archived` | A doc (and the subpages under it) was archived. |
| `doc.comment_assigned` | A doc comment was addressed to an account (an Ask); also on `doc.mentioned` with `asked`. |
| `doc.comment_edited` | A doc comment's body changed (before, after). |
| `doc.comment_resolved` | A review thread or Ask on a doc was resolved (`reason` resolved | replied | accepted) or reopened (`reason` reopened). |
| `doc.commented` | A comment on a doc (page or file): `after` is the comment (`comment_id`, `surface` review|discussion, anchor fields, `anchor_revision`, `mentions`, `parent_id` for a reply). |
| `doc.created` | A doc page was created (or duplicated); `after` is the page. |
| `doc.deleted` | An archived doc was deleted for good; `before` is its last state. |
| `doc.file_added` | An image or file was uploaded into a doc (metadata only). |
| `doc.file_removed` | A doc's file was removed. |
| `doc.mentioned` | A doc save added `@mentions` (`after.mentions`, `doc_id`, `title`, `excerpt`). Check-in news `mentioned`; inbox reason `mention`. |
| `doc.mentioned_agent` | A person @mentioned agents whose runner Slate can wake (wake `push`, and they may comment on the doc) on a page or in one of its threads (subject = the doc): `after.for` = their account ids (a `work` hint with `doc_id`, `thread_id`, `comment_id` on each one's stream; a runner takes it with `POST /work/next {doc_id, thread_id}`), `after.queued` = agents whose turn there is already open (the mention joins it). `thread_id` is null for a mention in the page body. An agent's mention of an agent never wakes it. `doc.mentioned` is still recorded for the inbox and check-in. |
| `doc.moved` | A doc moved or was reordered: before/after `{parent_id, section_id, list_id, position}`. |
| `doc.pinned_to_top` | A document was pinned to the top of its drawer or folder listing (`after`: at, by). Shared by everyone who sees the drawer. |
| `doc.revision_added` | A file doc got its next revision (`after`: revision_no, filename, size, note, restored_from; never bytes); the previous one is superseded. |
| `doc.revision_pinned` | A file doc's revision was marked as the one in use (`after`: revision_no, note; `before`: the previous pin or null). |
| `doc.revision_unpinned` | The pin came off a file doc (`before`: what was pinned). |
| `doc.suggestion_accepted` | A review comment's `suggestion_md` was applied to the page (`quote`, `suggestion`); the page save is its own `doc.updated`. |
| `doc.unarchived` | An archived doc was restored. |
| `doc.unpinned_from_top` | A document came off the top of its listing (`before`: at, by). |
| `doc.updated` | A doc's `title`, `icon`, `tags` or `body_md` changed (field, before, after); for `body_md`, before/after are `{version_no, chars}`: the page-history version holding the text (`GET /docs/{id}/versions/{n}`) and its length, not the text. Field `version_no` when a page-history version was closed without an edit. |
| `doc.version_restored` | An older version's title and body were put back (`restored_from`); before/after carry `title`, `version_no` and `chars`. |

## favorite

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `favorite.added` | Something was pinned to the favorites bar. |
| `favorite.moved` | The favorites bar was reordered. |
| `favorite.removed` | A favorite was unpinned. |

## health

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `health.alert` | A background poller (reminders, recurring tasks...) failed `health_alert_after` runs in a row (`after` = check, label, failures, error, last_ok_at). Owners and admins get it in their inbox; see `GET /health`. |
| `health.recovered` | A poller that raised `health.alert` works again (`after` as for health.alert). |

## inbox

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `inbox.cleared` | Inbox entries were cleared. |
| `inbox.read` | Inbox entries were marked read. |

## invitation

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `invitation.accepted` | Single-use invitation consumed; session linked. Actor is the guest. |
| `invitation.created` | A seven-day private-section guest/edit invitation. No secret or hash. |
| `invitation.revoked` | An invitation was cancelled: by an admin, with its browser session, or because the guest's section share was removed or a sibling link was cancelled. |

## item

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `item.archived` | An item was archived. |
| `item.assigned` | Assignees changed (`before`/`after` = sorted handles). Check-in news `assigned`/`unassigned`. |
| `item.attachment_added` | A file was attached. |
| `item.attachment_removed` | An attachment was removed. |
| `item.blocked` | An item now waits on an open item (a dependency was added, or a task it waits on was reopened); `after.blocked_by` = the open blockers. Derived, never set by hand. |
| `item.commented` | A comment was posted (`after` = the comment, mentions, reply_to). reply_to contains earlier discussion participants' account ids, excluding the author and an Ask's target (who gets comment.assigned instead). A reply never resolves an Ask. |
| `item.created` | An item was filed (`after` = the item). Never creates children. |
| `item.deleted` | An item was deleted for good (`before` = its last state). |
| `item.due` | Scheduler: the item's due time has arrived. A `work` hint for its agents. |
| `item.due_soon` | Scheduler: the item is due within the lead time (`after.lead_hours`). |
| `item.linked` | Two items were linked (blocks, waits on, relates to, duplicate of). |
| `item.mentioned` | An edit to a comment added `@mentions` (`after` = `{comment_id, mentions}`, only the newly added handles; a new comment's mentions ride on `item.commented`). Check-in news `mentioned`. |
| `item.moved` | An item moved to another list (`field` = `list_id`). |
| `item.overdue` | Scheduler: the item is an hour past due and not done. |
| `item.purged` | A trashed item was deleted for good, by hand or after the trash days (`before` = its last state). Its events stay. |
| `item.read` | An account opened an item; its comments so far are no longer new to it (the card's comment dot). `subject_id` is the account, `after.item_id` the item. |
| `item.reminder` | A reminder came due (actor `slate`, source `system`). Check-in news `reminder`. |
| `item.reminder_removed` | A reminder was removed. |
| `item.reminder_set` | A reminder was set on an item. |
| `item.reported` | An agent reported on an item: working, blocked, review, done or idle (`after` = the report, with `url` = where the agent is working; `thread` = its own session `{ref, url}` when new or changed; `waiting_on` = who a blocked report waits on, `again` true when it already waited on them, which makes this report their inbox `waiting` entry). Drives the live badge. |
| `item.restored` | An item came back from the trash (archived again if it was before). |
| `item.run_requested` | Run now: the item's agent assignees are asked to start on it now (`after.for` = their account ids, `after.reason` = `now` when someone pressed Run now, `due` when the scheduler reached the run time of an agent's task: 06:00 workspace time on the day for a date-only due date, else the due time). A `work` hint on each agent's stream; a runner takes it with `POST /work/next {item_id}`. |
| `item.split` | Subtasks were made from an item (`after` = the new ids). |
| `item.status_changed` | An item moved to another status (`before`/`after` = status ids). |
| `item.trashed` | An item went to the trash (`after` = `trashed_at`, `archived_at`); subtasks get one each. It is hidden like an archived item. |
| `item.unarchived` | An item was restored. |
| `item.unblocked` | The last open task an item waited on was done, cancelled, archived or unlinked: the item is free to start. `after.cleared_by` = the blockers this change closed or unlinked. Agents: treat it as new work becoming available. |
| `item.unlinked` | A link between two items was removed. |
| `item.unwatched` | Someone stopped watching an item. |
| `item.updated` | One item field changed (`field` = title, priority, due_at, tags, waiting_on, body...; `before`/`after`). |
| `item.watched` | Someone started watching an item. |
| `item.work_finished` | An agent finished a taken turn (`after.through` = its work-start event id, `outcome`). Earlier Ask assignments no longer dispatch that agent; they remain visible until resolved. New/reassigned Asks remain pending. |
| `item.work_started` | A work take's immutable Ask dispatch boundary (this event id). Resume and heartbeat do not move it. |

## list

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `list.archived` | A list was archived. |
| `list.created` | A list was created (with its statuses). |
| `list.statuses_changed` | A list's statuses (its columns) were replaced. |
| `list.unarchived` | A list was restored. |
| `list.updated` | A list changed (`field` = name, slug, position, section_id, default_status_id...). |

## message

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `message.agent_turn` | An agent's chat turn (`after.agent`): `state` started (taken with /work/next), done (`reply_id` = its message, or none), released (given up, nothing posted) or expired (the lease ran out; actor `slate`); `pending` true when a mention arrived during the turn and waits for the next take. |
| `message.deleted` | A chat message was deleted by its author or an owner or admin (the text goes, the thread stays; `before` keeps it). |
| `message.edited` | A chat message's text changed (`after.mentions` = handles the edit added). |
| `message.file_discarded` | An upload that was never sent was taken back or swept. |
| `message.file_uploaded` | A file was uploaded to send with a chat message (`after` = its metadata, no channel: until it is sent only its uploader hears of it; a sent message carries its files in `message.posted` `after.files`). |
| `message.mentioned_agent` | A person @mentioned agents whose runner Slate can wake (wake `push`, and they may post in the channel) in a chat message: `after.for` = their account ids (a `work` hint with `channel`, `thread_id`, `message_id` on each one's stream; a runner takes it with `POST /work/next {channel, thread_id}`), `after.queued` = agents whose turn there is already open (the mention joins it, no second run). An agent's mention of an agent never wakes it. |
| `message.posted` | A chat message was posted (`after` = the message, `channel`, `channel_name`, `mentions`; a reply also carries `thread_followers`, the account ids of the thread's earlier authors). Check-in news `mentioned` or `reply`. |
| `message.reacted` | An emoji reaction was added to a chat message. |
| `message.task_created` | A chat message was turned into a task (`item_id` = the new task). |
| `message.unreacted` | An emoji reaction was removed from a chat message. |

## push

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `push.expired` | A push subscription was dropped after the push service refused it. |
| `push.subscribed` | A device subscribed to Web Push notifications. |
| `push.unsubscribed` | A device unsubscribed from push. |

## recurrence

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `recurrence.advanced` | The rule's cursor moved with nothing else to record. |
| `recurrence.created` | A recurring rule was created. |
| `recurrence.ended` | A recurring rule was ended for good. |
| `recurrence.paused` | A recurring rule was paused. |
| `recurrence.reopened` | A recur-when-done rule reopened its done task with the next dates. |
| `recurrence.resumed` | A recurring rule was resumed. |
| `recurrence.rolled_forward` | A missed occurrence was rolled forward to the next date. |
| `recurrence.skipped` | A missed occurrence was skipped under the rule's policy. |
| `recurrence.spawned` | A rule filed its next occurrence (`item_id` = the new item). |
| `recurrence.updated` | A recurring rule changed. |

## section

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `section.archived` | A section was archived. |
| `section.created` | A section was created. |
| `section.participants_changed` | Refetch section participants; payload has no member details. |
| `section.unarchived` | A section was restored. |
| `section.updated` | A section changed (`field` = the column: name, position, audience, private, whiteboard_url). |

## session

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `session.created` | Thirty-day browser token expiry and marker set. No credential. |
| `session.expiring` | A guest browser session ends in three days (`after`: section, date, inviter; `for` = guest | inviter). Subject is the account told; inbox reason `access`. |
| `session.extended` | An admin pushed a browser session's `expires_at` out thirty days (subject = the token). A revoked session cannot be extended. |

## settings

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `settings.changed` | A workspace setting changed; `field` is its key (`agents.denied`: what agents may never do), `before`/`after` its values. |

## share

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `share.changed` | A share's level changed (`field` = `level`: view, comment, edit). |
| `share.granted` | A section or list was shared with an account (`after` = the share: account_id, scope_kind, scope_id, level). |
| `share.revoked` | A share was removed (`before` = the share). |

## tag

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `tag.created` | A tag was created (also when first used on an item). |
| `tag.deleted` | A tag was deleted (and taken off every item). |
| `tag.updated` | A tag was renamed or recoloured. |

## token

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `token.created` | A token was issued (never carries the secret). |
| `token.revoked` | A token was revoked (`field` = `revoked_at`). |

## view

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `view.archived` | A saved view was archived. |
| `view.created` | A saved view was created. |
| `view.unarchived` | A saved view was restored. |
| `view.updated` | A saved view's filters, grouping or layout changed. |

## webhook

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `webhook.created` | A webhook subscription was created. |
| `webhook.disabled` | A webhook subscription was disabled. |
| `webhook.enabled` | A webhook subscription was enabled. |
| `webhook.test` | `POST /webhooks/{id}/test` sent a test delivery. |
| `webhook.updated` | A webhook subscription's url, events or filter changed. |
